author: nickyeow

english.text: It occurred to me that I had left my purse at home.

jyutping: ngo5 dat6 jin4 gaan1 sing2 hei2 go3 ngan4 baau1 lau6 zo2 hai2 uk1 kei2。
text: 我突然間醒起個銀包漏咗喺屋企。

author: nickyeow

english.text: She ignored me even when she met me on the street.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 gaai1 dou6 gin3 dou2 ngo5 dou1 dong1 ngo5 mou5 dou3。
text: 佢喺街度見到我都當我冇到。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You mustn't answer your mother back when she scolds you.

jyutping: nei5 aa3 maa1 naau6 gan2 nei5 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 bok3 zeoi2。
text: 你阿媽鬧緊你嗰陣唔好駁嘴。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'll let you know when she arrives.

jyutping: keoi5 dou3 zo2 go2 zan6 ngo5 wui5 waa6 nei5 zi1。
text: 佢到咗嗰陣我會話你知。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you go abroad for pleasure or on business?

jyutping: nei5 ceot1 gwok3 hai6 heoi3 waan2 ding6 hai6 heoi3 zou6 je5 aa3？
text: 你出國係去玩定係去做嘢呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: He is playing golf.

jyutping: keoi5 hai2 dou6 daa2 gan2 go1 ji5 fu1 kau4。
text: 佢喺度打緊哥爾夫球。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why didn't you believe me?

jyutping: nei5 dim2 gaai2 m4 seon3 ngo5 aa3？
text: 你點解唔信我呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Did you feel the earth shake just now?

jyutping: nei5 gok3 m4 gok3 ngaam1 ngaam1 go3 dei6 hai2 dou6 zan3 aa3？
text: 你覺唔覺啱啱個地喺度震呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: She speaks as if she had really been in France.

jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 hou2 ci5 keoi5 zan1 hai6 heoi3 gwo3 faat3 gwok3 gam3。
text: 佢講到好似佢真係去過法國咁。

author: fercheung

english.text: You have only to push the button.

jyutping: gam6 go2 go3 zai3 zau6 OK gaa3 laa3。
text: 撳嗰個掣就OK㗎喇。

author: fercheung

english.text: It seems that you are very happy today.
It seems that you're very happy today.

jyutping: tai2 lai4 nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 ci5 hou2 happy wo3。
text: 睇嚟你今日好似好happy喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He plunged into the lake fully clothed.

jyutping: keoi5 lin4 saam1 dou1 mou5 ceoi4 zau6 tiu3 zo2 jap6 go3 wu4 dou6。
text: 佢連衫都冇除就跳咗入個湖度。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Let's eat out tonight!

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan1 ceot1 heoi3 sik6 aa1！
text: 我哋今晚出去食吖！

author: nickyeow

english.text: Are there any stores with "going out of business" sales?

jyutping: jau5 mou5 di1 me1 pou3 tau2 zou6 gan2 cing1 fo3 daai6 gaam2 gaa3？
text: 有冇啲咩舖頭做緊清貨大減價？

author: kaenif

english.text: I wish you were here with me now.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 ji1 gaa1 hai2 dou6 tung4 ngo5 jat1 cai4 zau6 hou2 laa3。
text: 如果你依家喺度同我一齊就好喇。

author: kaenif

english.text: Tom has three dogs.

jyutping: Tom jau5 saam1 zek3 gau2。
text: Tom 有三隻狗。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom thinks that Danish is the most beautiful language in the world.

jyutping: aa3 Tom gok3 dak1 daan1 mak6 man4 hai6 sai3 gaai3 soeng6 zeoi3 leng3 ge3 jyu5 jin4。
text: 阿Tom覺得丹麥文係世界上最靚嘅語言。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I thought we could talk about anything.

jyutping: ngo5 zung6 ji5 wai4 ngo5 dei6 mat1 dou1 gong2 dak1 tim1。
text: 我仲以為我哋乜都講得添。

author: nickyeow

english.text: An intellectual is a person who has discovered something more interesting than sex.

jyutping: zi1 sik1 fan6 zi2 zau6 hai6 faat3 jin6 zo2 bei2 bok1 je5 gang3 gaa1 jau5 ceoi3 ge3 je5 ge3 jan4。
text: 知識分子就係發現咗比扑嘢更加有趣嘅嘢嘅人。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Where is the nearest bank?

jyutping: zeoi3 gan6 ge3 ngan4 hong4 hai2 bin1 aa3？
text: 最近嘅銀行喺邊呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: What's the hotkey for inserting a non-breaking space?

jyutping: caap3 jap6 bat1 wun6 hong4 hung1 gaak3 ge3 faai3 zit3 gin6 hai6 me1 aa3？
text: 插入不換行空格嘅快捷鍵係咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I love the questions.

jyutping: ngo5 hou3 zung1 ji3 di1 man6 tai4。
text: 我好鍾意啲問題。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: I'm not stupid enough to lend him money.

jyutping: ngo5 jau6 mei6 ceon2 dou3 jiu3 ze3 cin2 bei2 keoi4。
text: 我又未蠢到要借錢畀渠。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: We were both tired.
Everyone is tired.

jyutping: daai6 gaa1 dou1 gui6 laak3。
text: 大家都攰嘞。

english.text: Determined attempts were made both openly and by stealth to strangle the system at its birth, to destroy the mustard seed at the time of the planting; and, as the fact of its survival has become prominent the certainty of its impending demise has been announced time and again; the fall of the umbrageous tree, amidst whose branches the birds of search continue to find food and shelter, has been often predicted.

jyutping: hai2 ni1 go3 hai6 tung2 ge3 daan3 sang1 go2 zan6，jau5 kyut3 sam1 ge3 soeng4 si3 hai6 gung1 hoi1 tung4 jan2 bai3 gam2 aak1 saat3 keoi5，hai2 zung3 zik6 go2 zan6 ceoi1 wai2 gaai3 coi3 zung2 zi2； ji4 ce2，ceoi4 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 sang1 cyun4 si6 sat6 bin3 dak1 dat6 ceot1，keoi5 zik1 zoeng1 mit6 mong4 ge3 kok3 ding6 sing3 zau6 jat1 ci3 jau6 jat1 ci3 bei6 syun1 bou3； ging1 soeng4 jau5 jan4 jyu6 cak1 dou3，ni1 fo2 cau2 lau6 ge3 syu6 wui5 hai2 keoi5 ge3 zi1 tiu4 jap6 min6 gai3 zuk6 wan2 sik6 mat6 tung4 bei6 naan6 so2。
text: 喺呢個系統嘅誕生嗰陣，有決心嘅嘗試係公開同隱蔽噉扼殺佢，喺種植嗰陣摧毀芥菜種子； 而且，隨住佢嘅生存事實變得突出，佢即將滅亡嘅確定性就一次又一次被宣布； 經常有人預測到，呢棵醜陋嘅樹會喺佢嘅枝條入面繼續搵食物同避難所。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Russian forests crash down under the axe, billions of trees are dying, the habitations of animals and birds are laid waste, rivers grow shallow and dry up, marvelous landscapes are disappearing forever.... Man is endowed with creativity in order to multiply that which has been given him; he has not created, but destroyed. There are fewer and fewer forests, rivers are drying up, wildlife has become extinct, the climate is ruined, and the earth is becoming ever poorer and uglier.

jyutping: ngo4 lo4 si1 ge3 sam1 lam4 hai2 fu2 tau2 haa6 dou2 taap3，gei2 sap6 jik1 fo2 syu6 sei2 gan2，dung6 mat6 tung4 niu5 leoi6 ge3 cai1 sik1 dei6 bei6 fong1 fai3，ho4 lau4 bin3 dak1 cin2 zo2 tung4 gon1 kok3，kei4 miu6 ge3 fung1 ging2 wing5 jyun5 siu1 sat1 gan2 .... jan4 leoi6 bei6 fu3 jyu5 zo2 cong3 zou6 lik6，wai6 zo2 faan4 zik6 keoi5 mou5 cong3 zou6 gwo3 ge3 je5，ji4 hai6 bei6 wai2 mit6 ge3 je5；
text: 俄羅斯嘅森林喺斧頭下倒塌，幾十億棵樹死緊，動物同鳥類嘅棲息地被荒廢，河流變得淺咗同乾涸，奇妙嘅風景永遠消失緊 .... 人類被賦予咗創造力，為咗繁殖佢冇創造過嘅嘢，而係被毀滅嘅嘢；

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: "Look out the window. The department head is playing Minesweeper again. If they have nothing else to do, why don't they just go home?" "Maybe the department head is trying to be considerate. They might feel it's not right to leave us, the people dealing with problems, behind." "Even then, what don't they realize? Look, they just hit another bomb."

jyutping: 「mong6 coeng1 ngoi6，bou6 mun4 fu6 zaak3 jan4 jau6 waan2 gan2 sou3 leoi4，jyu4 gwo2 keoi5 dei6 mou5 kei4 taa1 je5 zou6，dim2 gaai2 m4 zing6 hai6 faan1 uk1 kei2 ne1？」「ho2 nang4 bou6 mun4 zyu2 gun2 hai6 soeng2 tai2 tip3 di1。keoi5 dei6 ho2 nang4 gok3 dak1 lau4 dai1 ngo5 dei6 ne1 di1 cyu5 lei5 man6 tai4 ge3 jan4 hai6 m4 ngaam1 ge3。」「zau6 syun3 hai6 gam3，keoi5 dei6 dou1 m4 gok3 ji3 me1？tai2 haa5，keoi5 dei6 ngaam1 ngaam1 zong6 dou3 ling6 jat1 go3 zaa3 daan2。」
text: 「望窗外，部門負責人又玩緊掃雷，如果佢哋冇其他嘢做，點解唔淨係返屋企呢？」「可能部門主管係想體貼啲。佢哋可能覺得留低我哋呢啲處理問題嘅人係唔啱嘅。」「就算係咁，佢哋都唔覺意咩？睇吓，佢哋啱啱撞到另一個炸彈。」
